scope: Shared checkout verification hardening only; native runtime and canonical inputs unchanged

scopedChecks.scope: Fixture release/source guards and existing mutation/XML/package lanes; not full-suite or matrix rerun

verificationPolicy: Compare every tracked regular file with pinned HEAD raw Git blob hash
Require file and parent components not symlinks
Check Git owner-executable mode on POSIX independently of core.filemode
Disable Git replacement objects and optional index writes
Preserve index bytes and flags; clean flags alone do not refuse
review: Bounded independent read found no concrete issue within regular-file/non-adversarial-concurrency scope
limits: Not a claim of protection against arbitrary concurrent adversarial filesystem replacement
No new runtime, binding, central tag or catalogue execution credit
No full native matrix or wheel rerun for guard-only change
